acceptance_criteria.criterion: A fresh documented local setup can validate configuration, initialize the real correlated persistence schema, start the service without provider credentials, and expose truthful PAPER-mode health/status.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Execute the documented offline setup and startup procedure against a disposable local database, then inspect its health/status response and initialized schema.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: PAPER-only enforcement is mechanical, provider credentials remain server-side, and no live-trading route or endpoint is available.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Run the offline guard checks and inspect route registration and credential access boundaries.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Offline verification runs without credentials and reports credential-backed capabilities as unavailable or not configured rather than simulating success.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Execute the documented credential-free verification command with provider credentials absent and inspect its structured result.
